diagnosis: The prompt did not state strongly enough that each binding_table row is already grounded request-local evidence. The model therefore ignored the available selected_appointment binding and asked for an appointment identifier in thirteen explicit move, resize, cancel and status requests.
The natural response and typed form usually agreed, but agreement only proved internal consistency. It did not prove that either channel matched the staff request.

The deterministic proofreader validated schema, source types, operator arity, grounding and prose/form consistency, but had no one-way semantic assertion for explicit recognised intent cues or noun-only no-action input. It therefore admitted fourteen semantically wrong but structurally valid releases.
The noun-only details case shows the converse problem: the model inferred a create action that the user did not state.
One HTTP 200 response was rejected before candidate admission because its single text part was not JSON. No raw provider response or thought content was retained.

v5_comparison.interpretation: The receptionist-first framing improved the auditable natural channel but reduced exact typed performance on this reused development cohort; it is not evidence of generalisation.

prompt_context: Describe binding_table rows as broker-grounded stamped facts that the receptionist must use rather than re-litigate.
State that selected_appointment resolves which appointment is meant for move, resize, cancel and status work.
Retain the rule that noun-only details without an action remain clarification-only.
proofreader: Add a one-way recognised-intent assertion: when the deterministic adapter recognises an explicit non-clarification goal, the typed goal must agree.
Reject creation from a noun-only details utterance under the frozen no-action rule.
Keep unknown or novel action language eligible for model composition when no contradictory recognised cue is present.
recommended_repair.next_evaluation: Run a separately versioned targeted development repair over the fifteen misses; do not relabel it as a holdout.
